name: Kck Industries Ltd.
summary: Kck Industries Ltd. operates primarily in the trading and distribution of textile products and chemicals, and is also involved in rice milling and trading. The company distributes high-quality combed and carded cotton yarns, ranging from Ne 4 to Ne 40 in single and multifold, and knitted fabrics. These textile products cater to various applications within the apparel, undergarment, terry towel, denim, medical fabric, furnishing fabric, and industrial fabric industries. In its chemical division, Kck Industries Ltd. trades and distributes a diverse portfolio of chemicals and dyes, including basic chemicals, construction chemicals, and auxiliaries for the textile, leather, and paper industries. Additionally, the company owns and operates a rice shelling plant, processing both basmati and non-basmati rice for consumers. Kck Industries Ltd. serves a broad customer base across India, including the garment, industrial fabrics, and specialty chemicals sectors.
